text: My brother is a doctor.

chunks.label: 定语
chunks.note: 形容词性物主代词作定语

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: 不定冠词 + 名词作表语

keyPoints: 系动词 be 后面接表语，说明主语身份。
单数可数名词前要加不定冠词 a/an。

text: The children are playing in the garden.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 名词复数作主语

clauses.text: The children are playing in the garden.

keyPoints: the 用于双方已知或特指的名词。
现在进行时表示此刻正在发生的动作。

text: There is some milk in the fridge.

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: There be 句型的引导词，无实义

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 系动词，与真正主语保持一致

clauses.text: There is some milk in the fridge.

keyPoints: There be 句型表示“某处存在某物”，主语在 be 之后。
milk 是不可数名词，用 is 而不是 are。

text: These shoes are too expensive for me.
translation: 这双鞋对我来说太贵了。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 指示代词 + 名词复数作主语

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: too 修饰形容词，作表语

clauses.text: These shoes are too expensive for me.

keyPoints: these 指代近处的复数名词。
too + 形容词 + for sb. 表示“对某人来说太……”。

text: Each student has a new textbook.
translation: 每个学生都有一本新课本。

chunks.label: 定语
chunks.note: each 作定语，后接单数可数名词

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 冠词 + 形容词 + 名词作宾语

clauses.text: Each student has a new textbook.

keyPoints: each + 单数名词作主语时，谓语用单数。
a 用于单数可数名词前，表示“一本”。

text: She bought herself a birthday present.
translation: 她给自己买了一份生日礼物。

clauses.text: She bought herself a birthday present.

keyPoints: buy sb. sth. 是典型的双宾语结构。
主语和宾语指同一人时，宾语用反身代词。

text: The information you gave me was very useful.
translation: 你给我的信息非常有用。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定语从句主语，关系代词省略

clauses.note: 修饰 information，关系代词 which/that 作宾语已省略

keyPoints: information 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。
定语从句修饰先行词 information，关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省略。

text: Neither of the answers is correct.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: neither of + 复数名词作主语

skeleton: Neither of the answers is correct

clauses.text: Neither of the answers is correct.

keyPoints: neither of 表示“两者都不”，作主语时谓语用单数。
correct 作表语，说明主语的性质。

text: A few of my friends live abroad.
translation: 我有几个朋友住在国外。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: a few of + 复数名词作主语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，主语为复数

skeleton: A few of my friends live abroad

clauses.text: A few of my friends live abroad.

keyPoints: a few of 后接复数名词，谓语用复数。
abroad 是副词，前面不加介词。

text: The police are looking for the missing boy.
translation: 警察正在寻找那个失踪的男孩。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 现在进行时 + 短语动词

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: the + 现在分词作定语 + 名词

skeleton: The police are looking for the boy

clauses.text: The police are looking for the missing boy.

keyPoints: police 作主语时谓语通常用复数。
missing 是现在分词作定语，表示“失踪的”。

text: He can swim very fast.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 情态动词 + 动词原形

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 程度副词修饰方式副词作状语

keyPoints: 情态动词后必须接动词原形。
fast 在这里是副词，修饰 swim。

text: You must finish your homework before dinner.
translation: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 情态动词 must + 动词原形

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 物主代词 + 名词作宾语

clauses.text: You must finish your homework before dinner.

keyPoints: must 表示“必须”，后接动词原形。
before + 名词表示“在……之前”。

text: She has to work overtime tonight.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: have to 表示客观需要，后接动词原形

clauses.text: She has to work overtime tonight.

keyPoints: has to 是 have to 的第三人称单数形式，表示客观必要。
overtime 作副词，意为“加班地”。

text: We should protect the environment.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 情态动词 should + 动词原形

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 名词作宾语

keyPoints: should 表示建议或义务。
the environment 指我们共同的生活环境。

text: They might arrive late because of the rain.
translation: 因为下雨，他们可能会迟到。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 情态动词 might + 动词原形

clauses.text: They might arrive late because of the rain.

keyPoints: might 表示可能性较低。
because of 是介词短语，后接名词；because 后接句子。

text: I used to live in Shanghai.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: used to + 动词原形，表示过去的习惯

skeleton: I used to live in Shanghai

clauses.text: I used to live in Shanghai.

keyPoints: used to do 表示过去常常做，现在不了。
注意区分 be used to doing（习惯于）。

text: You had better see a doctor.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: had better + 动词原形，表示建议

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 不定冠词 + 名词作宾语

skeleton: You had better see a doctor

clauses.text: You had better see a doctor.

keyPoints: had better 后接动词原形，否定式为 had better not do。
see a doctor 是固定搭配，意为“看医生”。

text: He seems to know the answer.
skeleton: He seems to know the answer

clauses.text: He seems to know the answer.

keyPoints: seem 是系动词，可接不定式作表语。
seem to do 表示“似乎做某事”。

text: The soup tastes delicious.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 不可数名词作主语

keyPoints: taste 作系动词，后接形容词而不是副词。
类似用法的还有 smell、sound、feel。

text: Please turn off the lights.

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: 礼貌用语，不影响句子成分

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 名词复数作宾语

keyPoints: 祈使句以动词原形开头，主语 you 通常省略。
turn off 是“动词 + 副词”的短语动词。

text: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
translation: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: the + 最高级 + 名词作表语

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定语从句主语，关系代词省略

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 定语从句谓语，现在完成时

skeleton: This is the most interesting book

clauses.text: This is the most interesting book

clauses.note: 修饰 book，关系代词 that/which 作宾语已省略

keyPoints: 形容词最高级前通常加 the。
先行词在定语从句中作宾语时，关系代词可以省略。

text: He runs faster than his brother.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，不及物动词

clauses.text: He runs faster than his brother.

keyPoints: faster 是副词 fast 的比较级。
比较对象要一致：他和他哥哥比。

text: The weather is getting warmer and warmer.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 不可数名词作主语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 系动词 get 的进行时，表示状态变化

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: 比较级叠用，表示“越来越……”

clauses.text: The weather is getting warmer and warmer.

keyPoints: get 作系动词，后接形容词作表语。
比较级 + and + 比较级表示程度递增。

text: She is as tall as her mother.

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: as + 形容词原级 + as 同级比较

skeleton: She is as tall as her mother

clauses.text: She is as tall as her mother.

keyPoints: as ... as 中间用形容词或副词原级。
同级比较表示“和……一样”。

text: There are twenty students in the classroom.

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: There be 句型的引导词，无实义

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 系动词，与复数主语一致

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 数词 + 名词复数作真正主语

clauses.text: There are twenty students in the classroom.

keyPoints: twenty 是基数词，后接可数名词复数。
There be 句型中 be 与后面的真正主语保持一致。

text: I have two hundred books.

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 数词 + hundred + 名词复数作宾语

keyPoints: hundred 前有具体数词时，用单数形式。
hundreds of 表示“成百上千的”，要用复数。

text: He arrived on the third of May.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般过去时，不及物动词

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 序数词表日期，作时间状语

skeleton: He arrived on the third of May

clauses.text: He arrived on the third of May.

keyPoints: third 是序数词，表示“第三”。
具体某一天前用介词 on。

text: The sun rises in the east.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 独一无二的事物作主语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数

skeleton: The sun rises in the east

clauses.text: The sun rises in the east.

keyPoints: 世界上独一无二的事物前用定冠词 the。
表示客观规律用一般现在时。

text: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
translation: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 不定冠词 + 名词作主语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 名词作宾语

skeleton: An apple a day keeps the doctor away

clauses.text: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

keyPoints: keep + 宾语 + 形容词/副词表示“使……保持……”。
主语 an apple a day 视为单数，谓语用 keeps。

text: He speaks English very well.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 程度副词修饰方式副词

keyPoints: well 是副词，修饰动词 speak；good 是形容词。
very 修饰副词 well，作程度状语。

text: The cat is under the table.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 定冠词 + 名词作主语

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: 介词短语作表语，表位置

skeleton: The cat is under the table

clauses.text: The cat is under the table.

keyPoints: under 表示“在……下面”。
介词短语作表语，说明主语的位置。

text: We will meet at the station at six.
skeleton: We will meet at the station

clauses.text: We will meet at the station at six.

keyPoints: at 用于具体地点和具体时刻。
两个介词短语分别表示地点和时间。

text: He is good at playing basketball.

chunks.label: 表语
chunks.note: be good at + 动名词，作表语

skeleton: He is good at playing basketball

clauses.text: He is good at playing basketball.

keyPoints: be good at 表示“擅长”，at 是介词。
介词后面的动词要用动名词形式。

text: Although it was raining, they went out.
translation: 虽然当时在下雨，他们还是出去了。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 状语从句谓语，过去进行时

clauses.note: although 不能与 but 连用

keyPoints: although 引导让步状语从句，意为“虽然”。
英语中 although 和 but 不能同时使用。

text: Because he was ill, he stayed at home.
translation: 因为他病了，所以他待在家里。

clauses.note: because 回答 why

keyPoints: because 引导原因状语从句，语气最强。
英语中 because 和 so 不能同时使用。

text: Both Tom and Jerry are my friends.
translation: 汤姆和杰瑞都是我的朋友。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: both ... and ... 连接并列主语，谓语用复数

skeleton: Both Tom and Jerry are my friends

clauses.text: Both Tom and Jerry are my friends.

keyPoints: both ... and ... 连接两个主语时，谓语用复数。
并列连词连接的两个成分在句中作用相同。

text: Either you or he is wrong.

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: either ... or ... 连接并列主语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 谓语与最近的主语 he 保持一致

skeleton: Either you or he is wrong

clauses.text: Either you or he is wrong.

keyPoints: either ... or ... 表示“要么……要么……”。
连接并列主语时，谓语遵循就近原则。

text: Not only did she sing, but she also danced.
translation: 她不仅唱了歌，还跳了舞。

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 否定词置于句首，引起部分倒装

clauses.text: Not only did she sing, but she also danced
clauses.note: 两个分句由 not only ... but also ... 连接

keyPoints: not only 置于句首时，前一个分句要部分倒装。
not only ... but also ... 连接两个并列分句。

text: What a beautiful day it is!

clauses.text: What a beautiful day it is!

keyPoints: 感叹句结构：What + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓！
感叹句常把被感叹部分提到句首。

text: Oh no, I forgot my keys!

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: 感叹词，表示惊讶或懊恼

chunks.label: 宾语
chunks.note: 物主代词 + 名词复数作宾语

clauses.text: Oh no, I forgot my keys!

keyPoints: 感叹词独立使用，不作句子成分。
forget 的过去式是 forgot。

text: Birds fly.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: 主语 + 不及物动词构成主谓结构。
fly 在这里是不及物动词。

text: The baby smiled happily.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: 状语修饰谓语，说明动作方式。
主谓结构可以带状语，但仍是主谓句。

text: She opened the window.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语构成主谓宾结构。
open 在这里是及物动词。

text: My father bought me a new bike.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
translation: 我爸爸给我买了一辆新自行车。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 物主代词 + 名词作主语

skeleton: My father bought me a bike

clauses.text: My father bought me a new bike.

keyPoints: 双宾语结构中，间接宾语通常指人，直接宾语指物。
buy sb. sth. 可改为 buy sth. for sb.。

text: The teacher asked us to read the text.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句

chunks.label: 宾补
chunks.note: 不定式短语作宾语补足语

skeleton: The teacher asked us to read the text

clauses.text: The teacher asked us to read the text.

keyPoints: ask sb. to do sth. 是常见的宾补结构。
宾语 us 是 to read 的逻辑主语。

text: We elected him monitor.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: elect sb. + 职位名词，职位前通常不加冠词。
名词作宾补，说明宾语的身份。

text: The cake smells sweet.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: 系动词后接形容词作表语，不用副词。
smell 可作感官系动词。

text: He became a doctor.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: become 是系动词，后接名词或形容词作表语。
表语说明主语的身份。

text: They kept the room clean.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: keep + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“使……保持……”。
形容词 clean 说明宾语 the room 的状态。

text: I found the book interesting.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: find + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“发现……怎么样”。
interesting 说明宾语 the book 的性质。

text: She made him angry.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句
keyPoints: make + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“使……变得……”。
angry 说明宾语 him 的状态。

text: The meeting lasted two hours.
grammarPoint: 句子成分与五种简单句

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 时间状语，表示持续时长

keyPoints: last 是不及物动词，后面不是宾语而是时间状语。
表示持续多久用 for + 时间段。

text: Do you like classical music?

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 助动词提前，构成一般疑问句

keyPoints: 一般疑问句把助动词提到主语前。
实义动词 like 在疑问句中还原为原形。

text: Where did you buy that coat?
translation: 你在哪里买的那件外套？

clauses.text: Where did you buy that coat?

keyPoints: 特殊疑问句以疑问词开头，助动词提前。
did 后面的动词用原形。

text: Who is knocking at the door?

clauses.text: Who is knocking at the door?

keyPoints: 疑问词作主语时，语序与陈述句相同。
knock at the door 是固定搭配。

text: Open the door, please.
keyPoints: 祈使句以动词原形开头，主语省略。
please 可放在句首或句末。

text: Don't be late again.
keyPoints: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。
be late 表示“迟到”。

text: How beautiful the flowers are!

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 感叹句引导词，修饰形容词

keyPoints: 感叹句结构：How + 形容词/副词 + 主谓！
How 修饰形容词或副词。

text: How time flies!

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 感叹句引导词，修饰副词

keyPoints: 感叹句 How + 副词 + 主谓！
fly 在这里表示“（时间）飞逝”。

text: There will be a concert tomorrow.

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: There be 句型的引导词，无实义

clauses.text: There will be a concert tomorrow.

keyPoints: There be 句型表示“某处/某时存在某物”。
will be 后接单数主语 a concert。

text: I get up at seven every morning.

clauses.text: I get up at seven every morning.

keyPoints: 一般现在时表示习惯性动作。
get up 是“动词 + 副词”的短语动词。

text: She is reading a novel now.
translation: 她现在正在读一本小说。

clauses.text: She is reading a novel now.

keyPoints: 现在进行时结构为 be + 动词 -ing。
now 常与现在进行时连用。

text: They have lived here for ten years.
translation: 他们在这里住了十年了。

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 时间状语，表示持续时长

clauses.text: They have lived here for ten years.

keyPoints: 现在完成时表示过去开始、持续到现在的动作。
for + 时间段常与现在完成时连用。

text: He has just finished his homework.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 现在完成时，just 放在助动词后

skeleton: He has just finished his homework

clauses.text: He has just finished his homework.

keyPoints: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词。
just 通常放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

text: We visited the museum last Sunday.
translation: 上周日我们参观了博物馆。

clauses.text: We visited the museum last Sunday.

keyPoints: 一般过去时表示过去某个时间发生的动作。
last Sunday 是明确的过去时间。

text: I was watching TV when he called.
translation: 他打电话时我正在看电视。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 状语从句谓语，一般过去时

clauses.note: when 表示“当……的时候”

keyPoints: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。
when 引导的从句常用一般过去时，表示突然发生的动作。

text: She will call you tomorrow.
keyPoints: 一般将来时用 will + 动词原形。
tomorrow 表示将来的时间。

text: They are going to build a new bridge.

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: be going to + 动词原形，表计划

skeleton: They are going to build a bridge

clauses.text: They are going to build a new bridge.

keyPoints: be going to 表示计划或打算。
a new bridge 中 new 作前置定语。

text: By the end of last year, he had worked there for five years.
translation: 到去年年底，他已经在那边工作五年了。

chunks.text: By the end of last year,
chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 时间状语，by the end of + 过去时间

skeleton: He had worked there for five years

clauses.text: By the end of last year, he had worked there for five years.

keyPoints: 过去完成时表示“过去的过去”。
by the end of + 过去时间常与过去完成时连用。

text: The letter was written by Tom.

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: by 短语表示动作执行者

skeleton: The letter was written by Tom

clauses.text: The letter was written by Tom.

keyPoints: 被动语态结构为 be + 过去分词。
动作执行者用 by 引导。

text: The bridge is being repaired now.

clauses.text: The bridge is being repaired now.

keyPoints: 现在进行时被动语态结构为 is/are being + 过去分词。
repair 是及物动词，可用于被动语态。

text: The work will be finished by Friday.
translation: 这项工作将在周五前完成。

clauses.text: The work will be finished by Friday.

keyPoints: 一般将来时被动语态结构为 will be + 过去分词。
by Friday 表示“到周五为止”。

text: I like coffee, but my sister prefers tea.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 我喜欢咖啡，但我妹妹更喜欢茶。
skeleton: I like coffee, but my sister prefers tea

clauses.text: I like coffee, but my sister prefers tea
clauses.note: but 连接两个并列分句

keyPoints: 并列句由并列连词连接两个独立分句。
but 表示转折关系。

text: He is tired, so he went to bed early.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 他累了，所以早早上床睡觉了。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 第二分句谓语，短语动词

skeleton: He is tired, so he went to bed early

clauses.text: He is tired, so he went to bed early
clauses.note: so 连接两个并列分句

keyPoints: so 表示结果，连接两个并列分句。
go to bed 是固定短语，意为“上床睡觉”。

text: Study hard, or you will fail the exam.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 努力学习，否则你会考试不及格。
skeleton: Study hard, or you will fail the exam

clauses.text: Study hard, or you will fail the exam
clauses.note: or 连接祈使句和结果分句

keyPoints: 祈使句 + or + 分句，表示“否则……”。
or 在这里不是“或者”，而是“否则”。

text: I know that he is honest.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
skeleton: I know that he is honest

clauses.note: 主句谓语 know 后接宾语从句
that 在从句中不作成分，只起引导作用

keyPoints: 宾语从句用 that 引导时，that 可省略。
宾语从句要用陈述语序。

text: She asked me whether I could help her.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
skeleton: She asked me whether I could help her

clauses.note: ask sb. + 宾语从句
whether 表示“是否”

keyPoints: whether 引导宾语从句，表示“是否”。
宾语从句必须用陈述语序。

text: The book that you lent me is very interesting.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 你借给我的那本书非常有趣。

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 定语从句引导词，在从句中作宾语

clauses.note: 修饰 the book，that 作 lent 的宾语

keyPoints: 定语从句修饰前面的先行词。
关系代词 that 在从句中作宾语。

text: This is the house where I grew up.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 这就是我长大的那所房子。

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 关系副词，在定语从句中作地点状语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 定语从句谓语，短语动词

clauses.note: where 修饰表示地点的先行词

keyPoints: 先行词是地点时，定语从句可用关系副词 where。
where 在从句中作地点状语。

text: The news that he won the prize surprised us.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 他获奖的消息让我们很吃惊。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 主句主语，同位语从句的先行词

clauses.note: 解释 news 的具体内容

keyPoints: 同位语从句解释抽象名词的内容，that 不作成分。
注意区别于定语从句：that 在定语从句中要作成分。

text: What he said made us laugh.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句

chunks.label: 宾补
chunks.note: 不带 to 的不定式作宾语补足语

skeleton: What he said made us laugh

clauses.text: What he said made us laugh

clauses.note: 整个从句作主语

keyPoints: 主语从句可在句中作主语。
make sb. do sth. 中不定式不带 to。

text: It is important that we protect nature.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 我们保护大自然是重要的。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 形式主语，真正主语是后面的从句

skeleton: It is important to protect nature

clauses.note: 真正主语，it 为形式主语

keyPoints: it 可作形式主语，真正主语由 that 从句后置。
从句用陈述语序。

text: The reason why he left is unknown.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 他离开的原因还不清楚。

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 关系副词，在定语从句中作原因状语

clauses.note: 修饰 the reason

keyPoints: why 引导定语从句，修饰表示原因的名词。
unknown 作表语，表示“未知的”。

text: He ran so fast that nobody could catch him.
grammarPoint: 并列复合句和主从复合句
translation: 他跑得那么快，没人能追上他。

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 程度状语，so 修饰副词

clauses.note: so ... that ... 表示“如此……以至于……”

keyPoints: so + 形容词/副词 + that 引导结果状语从句。
that 从句中谓语用 could，表示过去的能力。

text: If I were you, I would apologize.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
patternName: 主谓+条件状语从句（虚拟）

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 条件状语从句引导词，虚拟语气

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 虚拟语气，与现在事实相反

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 主句谓语，would + 动词原形

clauses.note: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件

keyPoints: 与现在事实相反：从句用过去式，be 用 were。
主句用 would + 动词原形。

text: I wish I had more time.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 宾语从句谓语，虚拟语气

skeleton: I wish I had more time

clauses.note: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气

keyPoints: wish 后接与现在事实相反的愿望，从句用过去式。
had 在这里不是过去完成时，而是虚拟语气。

text: The man standing under the tree is my uncle.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
translation: 站在树下的那个男人是我叔叔。

chunks.label: 定语
chunks.note: 现在分词短语作后置定语

clauses.text: The man standing under the tree is my uncle.

keyPoints: 现在分词短语作定语，相当于 who is standing ...。
分词短语作定语放在名词之后。

text: Having finished the work, she went home.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 现在分词完成式作时间状语

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 主句谓语，go home 是固定搭配

clauses.text: Having finished the work, she went home.

keyPoints: 分词作状语时，其逻辑主语与主句主语一致。
having finished 表示动作先于主句动作发生。

text: To learn a language well, you need patience.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
translation: 要把一门语言学好，你需要耐心。

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 不定式短语作目的状语

clauses.text: To learn a language well, you need patience.

keyPoints: 不定式可作目的状语，表示“为了……”。
不定式的逻辑主语通常是主句主语。

text: I enjoy listening to music.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
keyPoints: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语。
listen to 是固定搭配。

text: He asked me to close the door.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构

chunks.label: 宾补
chunks.note: 不定式短语作宾语补足语

skeleton: He asked me to close the door

clauses.text: He asked me to close the door.

keyPoints: ask sb. to do sth. 是常见的宾补结构。
不定式的逻辑主语是宾语 me。

text: The homework finished, we went out.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
translation: 作业做完后，我们出去了。

chunks.label: 主语
chunks.note: 独立主格结构中的名词

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: 过去分词，与 homework 构成独立主格

clauses.note: 名词 + 过去分词，表示时间或原因

keyPoints: 独立主格有自己的逻辑主语，与主句主语不同。
过去分词表示被动或完成的动作。

text: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
translation: 我从没见过这么美的日落。

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 否定副词置于句首，引起部分倒装

skeleton: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset

clauses.text: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

keyPoints: 否定副词 never 置于句首时，助动词提前构成倒装。
现在完成时的过去分词 seen 保持不变。

text: It was Tom who broke the window.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构

chunks.label: 其他
chunks.note: 强调句的形式主语，无实义

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 强调句结构中的系动词

skeleton: It was Tom who broke the window

clauses.text: It was Tom who broke the window.

keyPoints: 强调句结构：It is/was + 被强调部分 + who/that + 其他。
被强调的是人时，连接词可用 who 或 that。

text: Hardly had he arrived when it began to rain.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
patternName: 主谓+时间状语从句（倒装）

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 否定副词置于句首，引起部分倒装

clauses.note: hardly ... when ... 表示“一……就……”

keyPoints: hardly 置于句首时，主句部分倒装。
hardly ... when ... 表示“刚……就……”。

text: The more you read, the more you learn.
grammarPoint: 从句进阶、非谓语与特殊结构
translation: 你读得越多，学到的就越多。

chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: the more ... the more ... 比较结构，引导状语从句

skeleton: The more you read, the more you learn

clauses.note: the + 比较级 ... the + 比较级 ... 结构

keyPoints: the + 比较级，the + 比较级，表示“越……越……”。
两个分句都用陈述语序。

text: The scientist whose research changed our lives won the prize.
translation: 那位研究改变了我们生活的科学家获奖了。

chunks.label: 连词
chunks.note: 关系代词，在定语从句中作定语

clauses.note: whose 表示所属关系

keyPoints: whose 引导定语从句，表示“……的”。
主句的主干是 The scientist won the prize。

text: Although the task was difficult, they managed to finish it on time.
translation: 尽管任务很难，他们还是设法按时完成了。
skeleton: they managed to finish it on time

clauses.text: they managed to finish it on time

clauses.note: although 表示“虽然”

keyPoints: manage to do 表示“设法做成某事”。
although 引导让步状语从句，不能与 but 连用。

text: I don't know whether the meeting will be held in the hall or in the classroom.
translation: 我不知道会议是在大厅还是教室举行。

chunks.label: 谓语
chunks.note: 宾语从句谓语，一般将来时被动语态

chunks.text: in the hall or in the classroom.
chunks.label: 状语
chunks.note: 宾语从句中的选择地点状语

skeleton: I don't know whether the meeting will be held

clauses.text: whether the meeting will be held in the hall or in the classroom
clauses.note: whether ... or ... 表示“是……还是……”

keyPoints: whether ... or ... 表示两种可能的选择。
宾语从句用陈述语序，被动语态为 will be held。

text: What surprised me most was that he refused to help.
translation: 最让我吃惊的是他拒绝帮忙。
patternName: 主系表+主语从句+表语从句
skeleton: What surprised me most was that he refused to help

clauses.note: 整个从句作主语

clauses.text: What surprised me most was that ...

clauses.note: 说明主语的内容

keyPoints: 主语从句 + 系动词 + 表语从句是常见长难句结构。
refuse to do 表示“拒绝做某事”。
